purpose: Shared implementation contract for the Familyfin native client and server bridge prototypes.
wireFormat: Envelope fields are explicitly camelCase. Embedded media is the standard Jellyfin BaseItemDto with its normal wire field names.
authentication: Existing authenticated Jellyfin viewer session. Every endpoint rechecks viewer and provider permissions. Never require admin for discovery or accept a caller-selected user identity.
identifierRules: Stable opaque IDs using letters, numbers, dot, underscore, colon and hyphen; no path separators, traversal, query strings, absolute URLs or control characters. Adapters may use base64url to encode legacy provider IDs.
behavior: Discovery hides inaccessible providers. Missing server bridge is normal and must not break the stock client.
Only same connected-server API requests; never attach credentials to plugin-supplied external origins.
Unknown protocol versions and action types are isolated to the extension and shown as unavailable, never guessed.
Native client has no special branches on provider IDs. Providers can be added through the server contract without client changes.
openGuide resolves a viewer-authorized scope immediately before navigation. Empty, denied or failed scopes never fall back to all channels.
Guide caches and lifecycle are isolated by server, viewer and scope; Back returns to the selected extension category.
Existing user home-row preferences remain respected; do not force disabled Live TV or On Now rows back onto home.
No server or household-device deployment during development. Validate on isolated fixtures/dev containers and emulators.
initialProviders: For You sections and paged media
Active Live-TV Control Center hierarchy and native guide scopes
acceptance: For You row added/reordered without APK change
Nested Live TV category to correctly scoped guide and one Back
Third provider rendered without client branches
Plugin absent, removed, malformed and unsupported-version handling
